purpose: Bounded future owned-knowledge runtime adaptation and maintenance evaluation; not retroactive L1 acceptance.
allowed_scope: Only owned result-package/recipe inputs in a dedicated isolated state; no native/omni source, source-tree membership, product workflow, shared S4 state or another session branch is edited.

bounds.additional_binding_review_requests: Two persistent judges for each changed exact candidate; account each visible request separately.
bounds.exhaustion: A failed case is reported and corrected only through a new linked bounded evaluation; do not silently extend these limits.

visibility: Reserved expected outcomes remain private. Public receipts will record only actual operations, results, scope and limitations.
